name: The fifth star
see: The dark after the Big Bang. Four tapped stars shine; one more twinkles somewhere.
after: The stars fly past at light speed, the planet comes closer and the stars light up as it arrives. Visible light, Starlight and Magma are known.

name: The dark sun
see: The planet in the dark, the stars out, the sun a dark disc.
play: Tap the sun again and again until its core lights.
after: Ignition: the sun shines at full light and the planet glows red.

name: The spin
see: The lit planet. It can be spun by swiping.
play: Swipe the planet to spin it faster and faster.
after: The moon flies out and the spin locks. Rotation is known; the Magnetic Field follows the crust.

name: The crust
see: The moon in the sky; the molten surface cooling.
play: Wait; the first tap on the moon finds its phase.
after: The crust sets and the first crack glows on it.

name: The first crack
see: A crack glows somewhere on the crust.
after: A volcano cone rises where it glowed.

name: The first eruption
see: A cone stands on the planet.
after: It rumbles, then erupts: lava, ash, gas, and the land grows round it.

name: Volcanoes
after: Restless Earth opens and Volcanoes is known; eruptions bring Volcanic Gas and Eruptions.

name: The first comet
see: Night. A comet crosses the sky.
after: It crashes into the planet; its card is found, Comets is known and the basins start to fill.

name: The thaw
see: A frozen planet; ice spots show where it can be chipped.
after: The ice melts into the first ocean.

name: Clouds
see: The ocean under the sun; a sun ray can be dragged onto the water.
play: Drag a sun ray onto open water, a few times.
after: Evaporation, then the first cloud plops out and Clouds is known; from then on the sun steams clouds up by itself.

name: The first storm cloud
after: They merge into a storm cloud, which rains, snows and strikes by itself.

name: Tides
see: The moon over the sea at night.
play: Drag the moon across the sky.
after: The sea bulges under it and lets go as a wave; tidal pools are left on the shore. From then on the tides roll in by themselves.

name: The soup
play: Tap a storm cloud three times over a pool, or wait for its own strike.
after: Lightning into a pool makes the soup of life; the Seas screen shows it build.

name: Life
after: The first cell; the Biology page opens and the species evolve one from another.

name: Land
see: Sea life; oxygen building in the air.
after: Plants go ashore and the land greens.

name: Dinosaurs
after: The dinosaurs; each night a body comes until one is caught.

name: The asteroid
see: Dinosaurs live; a body comes each night.
after: The asteroid falls and ends their age; mammals and birds take over.

name: Lucy
see: Mammals and birds after the impact.
